subject: Kickoff: Medicaresys security intake — IAM & compliance artifacts
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@medicaresys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Security & IAM kickoff — artifacts and timeline

Hi Claire — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and asks so we have alignment: 

Call highlights:
- Medicaresys is evaluating Redwood for inference (initial scope: patient-data anonymization workflows).
- Primary security topics you want validated: SOC 2 status, GDPR data residency, HIPAA/BAA needs, SSO/SCIM provisioning and RBAC, admin audit controls.

Immediate asks (can you confirm best way to share?):
1) SOC 2 report (Type II preferred) or SOC 2 readiness statement + expected completion date.
2) Any contractual requirements for HIPAA (do you require a BAA before a POC?).
3) GDPR/data residency constraints for EU patients (if applicable).
4) Your vendor security questionnaire (we can return answers in a spreadsheet or by DocuSign).

IAM-specific details we can provide today:
- SAML 2.0 / OIDC integration guide and example metadata
- SCIM provisioning (endpoints + attribute mappings), we support SCIM 2.0 with user/group provisioning and 2-way sync options
- RBAC model overview and recommended admin separation controls (audit logs + change history)

Proposed timeline and next steps:
- If you send the questionnaire, we’ll aim to turn around a completed response and an initial artifact bundle within 5 business days.
- Otherwise, we can schedule a 30-min technical follow-up next week to walk through SCIM attribute mapping and role matrix.

Attachments: I’ll attach a short artifact checklist for IAM to help you scope exact items (Redwood_IAM_Artifact_List_v1.pdf).

Thanks — I’ve CC’d Kimberly (security intake lead) and Priyom (solutions engineer) to coordinate artifact delivery.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment stub: Redwood_IAM_Artifact_List_v1.pdf (1 page)
From: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@medicaresys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Medicaresys Security <security@medicaresys.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 19:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & IAM kickoff — artifacts and timeline

Jonas — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our security team: 

- SOC 2: We are currently reviewing Redwood’s SOC 2 materials in parallel with procurement. We require either a SOC 2 Type II report or evidence of an active Type II engagement; expected completion is July 2027 in your case per the deck. Please confirm if that’s still accurate.
- HIPAA/BAA: Yes, for production access to any PHI we require a signed BAA. For an initial POC with de-identified data, we can proceed under a POC addendum but will need the BAA signed before pilot expansion.
- GDPR/data residency: We have EU patients in scope; please confirm whether you can guarantee EU region-only processing for the POC.

I’ve attached our vendor security questionnaire here for your team to complete and return (preferred in the Word doc). Also included is a short CSV with our minimum SCIM attribute set.

We can do a working session on Monday 26 Apr at 10am ET to walk through the SCIM mapping and RBAC questions — does that work for your team?

Thanks,
Claire Simmons
Head of Security Operations | Medicaresys
claire.simmons@medicaresys.com | +1 (617) 555-0228

Thanks — looping in a couple internal owners and proposed assignments: 

- Priyom: can you pick up the Medicaresys questionnaire and return a completed draft? Prioritize the IAM/SSO/SCIM/RBAC sections and note any gaps.
- I’ll gather the artifact bundle: SOC 2 readiness statement, SAML metadata, SCIM API spec, RBAC admin controls doc, and audit log sampling (sanitized).

Artifact list (what we can provide immediately):
1) SAML metadata file + OIDC table (saml-metadata.xml, oidc-config.json)
2) SCIM 2.0 endpoint spec + example provisioning payloads
3) RBAC matrix (roles.csv) and admin separation policy (pdf)
4) Audit/logging sample (sanitized last 30 days)
5) SOC 2: we currently have a Type II engagement in progress with expected completion July 2027 — will attach the readiness statement and control summaries.

Questions for Medicaresys (Claire):
- For SCIM, do you require group-to-role mapping during provisioning or will you accept group sync + on-platform role assignment?
- For the POC, can you confirm EU-only processing requirement (region)? If so, we’ll note that in the artifact bundle and include region-specific deployment notes.

Priyom, can you aim to return the questionnaire draft by EOD Tuesday 27 Apr? I’ll assemble the artifact ZIP and upload to the drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-iam-playbook
Kimberly Park
